description.content:
#### Modes
Levels of detail in the response - `list`, `normal`, `detailed`

Example - [/payload_flights/?mode=list](./?mode=list)

#### Filters
Parameters - `payload`

Example - [/payload_flights/?payload=2](./?payload=2)

#### Number of results
Use `limit` to control the number of objects in the response (max 100)

Example - [/payload_flights/?limit=2](./?limit=2)

#### Format
Switch to JSON output - [/payload_flights/?format=json](./?format=json)

#### Help
Find all the FAQs and support links on the documentation homepage - [ll.thespacedevs.com/docs](https://ll.thespacedevs.com/docs/)
